title: SqueakyClean: The Ultimate Messy Data & JSON Repair Tool
target_pain: Developers, data analysts, and creators waste hours manually fixing broken JSON, cleaning duplicate CSV rows, and extracting structured data from messy text logs.
key_features: Auto-repair broken JSON (fixes trailing commas, missing quotes, single quotes)
Smart CSV/TSV deduplicator, delimiter standardizer, and whitespace trimmer
Regex-powered structured data extractor (emails, URLs, custom patterns)
Instant export to clean JSON, CSV, or Markdown
100% client-side processing for maximum data privacy
